column6: v2. Merge is irreversible in every product that ships it (HubSpot unenrols workflows and resets timestamps; Bigin Attio and OnePageCRM all warn it cannot be undone). The reversible 'Mark as duplicate of' flag in FEAT-0011 covers the need without destroying data, and dedupe-at-import in FEAT-0004 prevents most of it. Revisit when a real user asks.

Deliberately replaced by FEAT-0013. A recurring task fires whether or not anything happened — if the stockist reordered yesterday the task still fires, and four dismissals later the user stops trusting the task list. An inactivity signal fires only when the relationship actually went cold and self-clears. LACRM and OnePageCRM — the two closest comparables — ship no recurrence at all. No evidence found of anyone abandoning a CRM over this. For genuine admin recurrence the answer is the phone's reminders app.
